messages:
emily (release-manager): RC build finished: rc-2026.03.21-5 — artifacts pushed (inference-service:rc-2026.03.21-5, frontend:rc-2026.03.21-5). Requesting pin for model variant and keep DB migration flag OFF for initial prod promo. Target promo window 21:00-22:00 PT. Release notes: https://gist.github.com/abcd1234

deploy-bot: scheduled promo job created for rc-2026.03.21-5. Canary plan: 1% -> 10% -> 50% over 15m, then 100%. KV warm queued. Manual hold enabled for 5m.

sam (sheriff): reading. Need QA thumbs and rollback plan. Any migration risks?

maria (qa): ran quick staging smoke: `pytest tests/e2e::smoke -k rc-2026.03.21-5` — all green. Latency +2ms, no 5xx spikes. Will watch for longer after canary.

leo (platform): we should pin the quantized model to avoid runtime mismatch. Suggest `llm-v2-quant-8bit@sha256:deadbeef`. Also confirm kernel selection across Dedicated pool.

olivia (backend): DB migration is additive (add column) behind feature flag `db.migrate.v2`. Recommend keep flag OFF until 50% traffic and enable later via a separate rollout. No schema-destructive ops.

emily (release-manager): consensus: pin model to `llm-v2-quant-8bit@sha256:deadbeef` and keep `db.migrate.v2` OFF for initial promo. Anyone object to 21:00 PT window? :hourglass_flowing_sand:

jake (infra): reserved Dedicated pool for the window. Autoscale min=4, max=16. Network egress quota ok.

maria (qa): +1 from QA, I'll hold extended smoke after 30m.

sam (sheriff): +1, I'll be on-call for the window. Rollback trigger thresholds?

emily (release-manager): rollback criteria: immediate rollback to prod tag `prod-2026.03.20-9` if error rate > 1% sustained for 5m, or P95 latency > 500ms. Rollback command documented and tested.

deploy-bot: running preflight checks: image sigs ok, canary config validated, kv-warm scheduled. Preflight: PASS ✅

emily (release-manager): prepping to /promote in 2m. Reminder: keep migration flag OFF, model pinned as noted.

olivia (backend): rollback path confirmed. No DB rollback needed because migration flag off.

deploy-bot: /promote initiated by emily. Starting canary at 1%. Will report status updates.

deploy-bot: canary 1% complete — error rate 0.12%, latency within SLO. Advancing to 10%.

maria (qa): sampling traces, NLU scoring stable. No regressions observed. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: 10% -> 50% in progress. KV warm 80% warmed.

jake (infra): infra metrics look healthy, GPUs not saturated.

deploy-bot: 50% complete. Observability: error rate 0.08% over 10m. Shall we proceed to 100%?

emily (release-manager): go to 100%.

deploy-bot: promoting to 100% now. Promo complete. New prod tag: prod-2026.03.21-5.

sam (sheriff): monitoring live. Ping me if anything > thresholds.

maria (qa): kicking off regression suite every 15m for the next hour. Reporting back if any drift.

leo (platform): kicking routing job to ensure model pinned across all regions.

emily (release-manager): release notes posted to #release-notes: https://company.internal/release-notes/2026-03-21. Short summary + migration guidance included. Thanks all :party_parrot:

olivia (backend): follow-up: schedule separate RC next week to roll `db.migrate.v2` ON gradually. Will coordinate with infra and QA.

sam (sheriff): closing thread; all green at T+30m.

emily (release-manager): closing. Great job everyone.
